SRC-360:R001.text: D-01 Response-Contract-Enforcement: Typed rendering prevents model overwriting STALE_FAIL with PASS

SRC-360:R002.text: D-02 Review-Revision-Discipline: Edits in REVIEW invalidate review approval and require BUILD->VERIFY->REVIEW loop

SRC-360:R003.text: D-03 Test-Coordinator-Efficiency: Event-driven waiting replaces sleep-poll loops and marks canceled runs distinctly

SRC-360:R004.text: D-04 Delivery-Transparency: Distinct reporting of NOT_APPLICABLE vs VERIFIED with explicit external handoff

SRC-360:R005.text: D-05 Baseline-Red-Reporting: Engine reports ran, baseline red, and new red distinctly instead of masked PASS
